items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: I played a couple of Bonquets there with George Astute and Joe Nicklaus

ctx.x: Did you ever hear any music over, there's a new hall up there on Durbanese Street?
Well I played there a couple of times with George Astute, I played a couple of Bonquets there with George Astute and Joe Nicklaus and that bass player, what's his name again?
I played a couple of times with a couple of times with a drum. I played a drum. I played a drum.
